title: Conditional κ = 0.00304117 (+6.0e-7 over #5544)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This conditional construction raises complete **κ from 0.00304057 in [PR #5544](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5544) to 0.00304117**, a gain of **0.00000060**. It changes the paid profile. The selected record, 0.003027288235, remains unchanged.

The change moves one subtraction and sign, on P104 registers 341 and 345, from a four-dimensional frame to the full nine-dimensional frame. Five source sites change. The old path pays H1 + 2H5; the new path pays H5 + H6. Each of the 18 full calls therefore saves H1 + H5 − H6. For every power `0 < t < 1`, `6^t < 1 + 5^t`. All independent inputs, productive outputs, scalar coefficients and owned lifetimes remain fixed.

| Complete invoice | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Paid calls | 69,930 | 69,912 |
| Productive fields | 12,814 | 12,814 |
| Target minus paid rank mass | 760 | 760 |
| Conditional κ | 0.00304057 | 0.00304117 |

The exact complete paid delta is `{1:-18, 5:-18, 6:18}`; the target delta is zero. The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc/research/p104-full-frame-contact/PROOF.md) gives the all-width common-chart identity and complete transfer. The [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc/research/p104-full-frame-contact/RESULT.json) contains both full histograms and exact inequalities. The raw crossing is in `(0.00304117181649, 0.00304117181650)`, an increase between `0.00000059374018` and `0.00000059374020` over the source crossing. The endpoint gain also reflects the two different safety margins. This fixed invoice has a unique crossing; no optimum over other constructions is claimed.

Five framework assumptions remain: native all-column implementation, owned erasure, uniform compiler, precision/tape costs and analytic recovery. The enormous uniform word and complete rounded multiplier are not materialized. These are author-side exact checks, with no independent human acceptance or proof-kernel theorem.

## Task and overlap

Task `scalar-to-moment`, priority revision 7; [scope and handoff](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc/research/p104-full-frame-contact/TASK.json). Scope is refined to this literal paid-path change. The donor requires a κ improvement. The newly released PR5544 supplied a useful complete caller after earlier screens found no gain.

Research started from canonical main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`, which remains current after the final fetch. Immediate predecessor: PR5544 at `e2a6cce2f9db5a2c5f9714f4b9e5292dd3a10581`. This PR retains that original commit as a dependency. The successor adds only `research/p104-full-frame-contact/`; the predecessor package is unchanged. Review only this contribution in the [two-commit successor diff](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/compare/e2a6cce2f9db5a2c5f9714f4b9e5292dd3a10581...18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc). Final head: `18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc`.

The [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19169220) records the scope changes. The final overlap refresh covered 403 open PRs and 4,828 Discussion records. The exact register/contact search found only this claim. Local package-note coverage was sparse and was supplemented with relevant Git-object reads; no exhaustive novelty claim is made. The existing shared-chart and dual-ADD packages supply the general retiming method. This contribution is the new source contact and its fully charged endpoint.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.14, macOS, standard library. Both registered normal and optimized replays passed:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-full-frame-contact
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-full-frame-contact --check-only
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-full-frame-contact
```

Expected marker: `PASS_P104_CONTACT_COMPLETE_KAPPA_00304117`.

Two exact endpoint interpreters check all 552,049 public/owned coefficients. Native checks cover 2,981 distinct paid/helper maps, 208 main adapters, all 1,054 normalizers for 527 helpers, 7,488 caller contacts, and every main/idle target phase. Two rational moment engines, completion tails, compiler threshold `N=2^337848000000000`, ordinary BIT stock, and all 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates pass. The shared signed-invoice comparator reports `uniformly_better`.

Controls reject a one-sided move, wrong sign, intervening source read, omitted paid charge, missing central translation, native phase error, old cutoff and insufficient BIT stock. The read-only, Git-free optimized export replay passed in 73 seconds with all 34 exported files unchanged. A changed-source control failed before imports. Committed bytes, metadata/pins and export integrity passed at the final head. Scientific code, receipts and inputs are byte-identical to the tested scientific commit `bea205d91409506c794ababd81454ca42450d5d2`; only proof and validation prose changed afterward.

The optional full-history preflight could not run because the checkout is shallow. Direct base/predecessor ancestry and all source-byte checks passed. See [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc/research/p104-full-frame-contact/VALIDATION.md) and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc/research/p104-full-frame-contact/SOURCES.json). Hosted CI is separate from these local results.
